event_class.dataset: zeroshot/twitter-financial-news-topic (validation, MIT), mapped to our taxonomy
event_class.caveat: The topic taxonomy is not ours; the mapping is approximate (e.g. 'Markets' -> routine), so absolute scores understate the classifier. Reported for reproducibility, not as a headline.

entity_link.dataset: FNSPID ticker tags on headlines for in-universe US tickers
entity_link.note: Headline-only linking (article bodies are not used), so recall is a conservative floor. Precision is not measurable from tags because untagged mentions can be correct.

event_study.caveat: Concurrent validation, not forecasting. News is day-resolution, social posts partly react to the move. Abnormal return = stock return minus beta x S&P 500 return, same day.
